mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS due_goal_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN completed_time IS NOT NULL AND completed_time < LEAST(#{cutoffExclusiveDate}, NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_goal_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN completed_time IS NULL OR completed_time > end_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_goal_count FROM stage_goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND end_time >= #{startDate} AND end_time < LEAST(#{cutoffExclusiveDate}, NOW())

SELECT stage.id AS goal_id, stage.title, stage.category, stage.status, GREATEST( COALESCE(MAX(checkin.checkin_date), DATE(stage.create_time)), CASE WHEN DATE(stage.update_time) <= #{cutoffDate} THEN DATE(stage.update_time) ELSE DATE(stage.create_time) END ) AS last_activity_date, DATEDIFF( #{cutoffDate}, GREATEST( COALESCE(MAX(checkin.checkin_date), DATE(stage.create_time)), CASE WHEN DATE(stage.update_time) <= #{cutoffDate} THEN DATE(stage.update_time) ELSE DATE(stage.create_time) END ) ) AS inactive_days FROM stage_goal stage LEFT JOIN goal_checkin checkin ON checkin.stage_goal_id = stage.id AND checkin.user_id = #{userId} AND checkin.is_deleted = 0 AND checkin.checkin_date <= #{cutoffDate} WHERE stage.user_id = #{userId} AND stage.status IN (0, 1, 2) AND DATE(stage.create_time) <= #{cutoffDate} GROUP BY stage.id, stage.title, stage.category, stage.status, stage.create_time, stage.update_time HAVING last_activity_date <= #{staleBeforeDate} ORDER BY inactive_days DESC, stage.id DESC LIMIT 100
